top_signals.title: Congo Closes on Top Copper Supplier Chile as Exports Soar Again
top_signals.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is closing the gap on the world’s top copper producer Chile, after quarterly exports topped 1 million tons for the first time in the three months through September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Japan Tobacco studies deal for Imperial Brands
top_signals.summary: Japan Tobacco has been considering teaming up with a partner on an acquisition of Imperial and then splitting up the British company's assets.
